Commentary.Commentary: So we have witnessed another clinical performance from Afghanistan. They are outplaying Ireland with utmost ease, having all their bases covered. The hosts need to do something out of the blue if they are to keep the series alive. Join us for the 2nd ODI in Belfast on 29th August at 1045 Local (0945 GMT) to catch all the action. Till then, cheers!

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan, says the first game of a series is important, so is happy to win it. Credits his side's fielding in today's match. Reckons they didn't finish well in the death overs but have plenty of positives to take and a lot to learn. Thanks the fans at the end of his interview for coming out and supporting the team.

Ireland captain, William Porterfield, says it was tricky but he's happy with how his side has performed. Feels they leaked a few runs towards the end which he rues. Applauds Andy Balbirnie for playing well but is disappointed the rest couldn't chip in with partnerships. Admits there's plenty of work to be done. Reckons in the first 25-30 overs, they were behind the pace in terms of fielding. Ends by saying they will try to do better in the next game.

Earlier, Gulbadin Naib and Hashmatullah Shahidi took the tourists to a decent total on a two-paced surface, courtesy their half centuries. Their bowlers came to the party, with each one picking up a wicket at least. The fielders were on the money as well and took some good catches. Ireland have a lot of catching up to do in terms of every department. In terms of runs, 29 to be precise, this is Afghanistan's fourth closest win in ODIs. The Presentation is coming up in a while...

It was only Andy Balbirnie who applied himself and kept his side in the hunt, with a well-crafted fifty. He was involved in a run out though, Niall O'Brien being the victim. No other batsman stood out as the visitors kept on picking wickets at regular intervals. Gary Wilson hung in till the fag end but was not able to accelerate and the mounting run rate got the better of him.

A brilliant bowling performance from Afghanistan has seen them continue their domination over Ireland on this tour. However, the hosts' batsmen were themselves not proactive enough as they didn't rotate the strike consistently and were not wise with their shot selections as well. The openers, William Porterfield and Paul Stirling, got off to starts but threw their wickets away.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Afghanistan go 1-0 up in the 3-match series. Another flighted delivery outside off, Chase gets down to play the slog sweep but only top edges it high in the air. The ball has barely gone anywhere while Rashid goes back slightly and takes it calmly. VICTORY BY 29 RUNS!
Peter Chase is the last man in.

OUT! Another one hits the sticks. Tossed up around middle, Wilson gets down to play the slog sweep but misses and the ball hits the middle stump. A strange innings from Wilson. Never looked to accelerate.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Boyd Rankin walks in at number 10, replacing Murtagh.
OUT! Bowled! A length ball outside off, Murtagh backs away and swings hard. But he makes no contact with the ball and it hits the off stump.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Aftab Alam is swung around. 8-2-31-1 so far.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.

DROPPED! That should have been taken. Full and outside leg, Wilson looks to play the reverse sweep but gets a bit of a bottom edge. The ball deflects onto his pads and then lobs in the air. The keeper takes a while to realize where the ball is, sets off late, puts in a dive to his right, gets to the ball too. But fluffs it. A single taken.
Very full, on off, whipped to long on for a single. Gets off the mark.
Full and outside off, Murtagh looks to swing but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.

SIX! THWACK! Ireland needed that. Wilson needed that. The crowd needed that. A boundary after 78 balls! The last one came on 32.5 when Balbirnie had got a four. This one is tossed up outside off, Wilson gets down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket! This is Wilson's first boundary as well! On his 45th ball. 39 needed from 24 balls. Meanwhile, that spoils Nabi's figures a bit. Ends up with 10-0-42-2.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads They pick up a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Comes down the track and hits it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, chipped over cover for a couple.
Tim Murtagh walks in at number 9, replacing McBrine.

OUT! Another one goes down. The boundaries drying up were building pressure and eventually McBrine is consumed by it. Tossed it outside off, Andy comes down the track and looks to go downtown. But he doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball and skies it high in the air. Substitute Najibullah Zadran comes running in from long off and takes it comfortably. So the LBW shout which was denied in the previous over, does not make much of a difference.
Short, on off, whipped through mid-wicket for a single. 49 more needed from 29 balls.
Mohammad Nabi is back on. 9-0-32-1 so far.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Pushes this through mid-wicket for a run.

Massive shout for LBW! Looks dead plumb. But the umpire meets it with a shake of his head. Oh dear... Rashid cannot believe it. This was the googly, from around the wicket, McBrine played that from the crease, looking to defend but missed it totally. Was hit on the back pad, right in front of middle. However, the umpire thought otherwise.
Full and outside off, Gary looks to sweep but gets a thick inside edge which goes off his pads towards short fine leg. A quick single taken.
Ooohhh! The googly, on off, McBrine looks to cut but ends up being too close to the ball. Gets a bottom edge which just misses the stumps and goes to short third man. A run taken.
Full and outside off, swept away for a single.
A full ball, pushed past the bowler for a single to mid on.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Lucky! A short ball outside off, Wilson looks to pull but the ball gets big on him. It takes the top edge but does not carry to fine leg. A run taken.
On middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Full and outside off, pushed down to long on for a run.

A slight delay. The bowler seems to have some issue on his spikes as he sits down to clean his boot. Now, the captain Afghan walks over to him to check on his bowler. Even umpire Gould joins the party. Eventually, everyone is ready.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Aftab Alam is back on. 7-2-26-1 so far.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

Full and outside off this time, Gary looks to sweep again but misses. The ball spins away, beats the keeper and the batsmen return for the second as the ball goes to the third man fence. It is retrieved by some team work.

Full and down the leg side, Wilson looks to sweep but misses. The keeper fumbles the catch as well. Was there any glove? Rashid is appealing. But for what? Perhaps he did not see that the keeper did not collect it cleanly.
Full on off, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
The googly, outside off, McBrine looks to cut but misses.
Around off, worked wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single. That is the end of Mujeeb. Not much wickets but he has kept a lid on the proceedings. 10-0-32-1.
Outside off, pushed towards long off for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Full on off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl out.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. The fielding side are asking the question. The umpire isn't interested in the appeal.
Full and on off, swept through mid-wicket for a couple.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
IS THAT OUT? Nope. Beautiful ball. Tossed up outside off, McBrine looks to drive but it turns out to be a googly. Misses the bat and the keeper's gloves and goes straight to first slip.
Full and outside off, swept powerfully through mid-wicket for a single.
POWERPLAY 3 time. Five fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Rashid Khan is back on as well. 5-0-23-0 so far.

A short ball, McBrine looks to pull but gets a top edge. It lands safely and almost goes to the boundary at square leg but Mujeeb Ur Rahman rushes to his right from fine leg and puts in a good slide. Keeps the batsmen to a couple.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Banged in short, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
On off, on a length, defended from the crease towards cover.
Aftab Alam is the bowler to bowl now. 6-2-22-1 so far.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Pushes it back to the bowler.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Andy McBrine is the new man in at number 8, replacing Kevin O'Brien.

OUT! Yup, he knows there is no point waiting. Big blow. Kevin O'Brien is not going to produce any show. Second run out of the innings. Full and outside off, Wilson brings out his reverse sweep and deftly guides it through third man. Aftab Alam chases it down from backward point and gets to the ball, with a brilliant dive. Now, till this phase, the batsmen had taken two. But on seeing that effort, O'Brien goes for the third. Why? Because though the ball did not cross the ropes, Alam did. KOB thought there was that third on offer but Mujeeb Ur Rahman coming in from third man did the mop up and fired a good throw to the keeper who did the rest. Replays show that Kevin O'Brien is short. Well, that door now, is well ajar for the visitors.
Is Kevin O'Brien gone? Referred upstairs but KOB is walking back. Trouble, trouble, trouble.
Tossed up outside off, Gary looks to drive but misses.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Fuller, whipped towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A touch short, punched down to long on for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Just a couple on the Free Hit. Full and outside off, punched through point for a brace.
FREE HIT COMING UP!
NO BALL! Full and outside off, O'Brien drives it on the bounce straight to cover. The umpire indicates that Mujeeb has overstepped...

Tossed up wide outside off, Wilson goes hard on the drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes towards short third man. The fielder puts in a dive to his left and makes a tumbling stop. A run taken.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.

DRINKS BREAK. Good, tight contest so far. Ireland have just been in it, thanks to the fight from Andy Balbirnie. But for them to win, the others need to contribute as well. This stand between Kevin O'Brien and Gary Wilson needs to be productive. As far as Afghanistan are concerned, once again, the spinners have bowled beautifully. Smart captaincy too. Out of the 14 overs remaining, 10 can be bowled by the trio of Mujeeb, Rashid and Nabi. Looks like the visitors have all their bases covered. He is ringing in the changes constantly. A change of ends for Mujeeb.
On off and middle, watchfully defended.
LUCKY! This was slid through from Nabi, Wilson went back and looked to flick but hit it a tad uppishly. Luckily for him, the ball did not carry to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Shorter, punched back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, a tad short, pushed into the off side comfortably, towards cover, for a single.
Mohammad Nabi is back on. 7-0-25-1 so far.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Outside off again, Wilson looks to cut but is too close to the ball and gets a bottom edge which is gathered by the keeper on the bounce.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, swinging a long way away, Wilson slashes hard but misses.
On a length outside off, pushed towards point.
Gulbadin Naib is back on. 9-1-40-1 so far.
Full and outside off, spinning in, pushed back to the bowler.
Gary Wilson walks in at number 7, replacing Balbirnie.

OUT! Taken at short fine leg! Mujeeb has delivered the much-needed breakthrough. And it is a big one too. That of the set Balbirnie. The carrom ball, full and outside off, Balbirnie gets down and attempts a paddle sweep. Initially it looks like he has cleared the fielder but Aftab Alam times his leap to perfection and takes it. Mujeeb stands over there with his arms aloft. That should open the door a bit more for the Afghans. Ireland now need 98 more from 97 balls.
Too full, driven wide of short extra cover for a run.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, tapped towards point.
Full and outside off, Balbirnie pushes but misses.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back on. 6-0-18-0 so far.
Full and outside off, driven straight to the bowler.
FOUR! Terrific shot. A long hop, Balbirnie pulls it with brute force behind square leg. There is mid-wicket in place but he cannot get to the ball. Dives in vain.
A short ball outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full on off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The googly, around off, spinning in sharply, AB looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. LBW appeal turned down. Going down leg.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for one more.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Too full outside off, drilled down to long off for a run.

HALF CENTURY FOR BALBIRNIE! A very important one at that. Ireland need him to be till the very end if they have to get anywhere close. Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single. This is the 6th half century for Balbirnie in ODIs. He has surpassed the 3-figure mark twice. Not a bad time to make it thrice.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
FOUR! Second one of the over. Short and wide outside off, Balbirnie crashes it behind point this time. Third man does not even have a chance. 109 more needed from 115 balls.
Outside off, a touch fuller, Andy slashes but misses.

FOUR! THUNDEROUS! Ireland need more of that. Short and wide outside off, Balbirnie opens his arms and then throws them hard. Now, don't go literally by the meaning. Bashes it over a leaping point fielder to find the fence. The stand is now worth 22 from 22 balls.
This is on a length, around middle, angling down, tucked behind square leg for a run. Moves to 10 from 9 balls.
On a length around off, pushed towards point for a single. Moves to 40 from 71 balls.
Slower through the air, milked down to long on for a single.
Fuller in length, eased through mid on for a run.
Floated outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a single.

What is happening? Once again Balbirnie's miscommunication could have resulted into a disaster. Full ball outside off, Andy squeezes it towards the left of backward point. He takes off initially but then puts his bat up to his partner. O'Brien turns but slips. Somehow he recovers as the throw from the fielder comes in towards Rashid. He loses a bit of balance and fails to collect it cleanly. Had he done so, Kevin might have been found wanting. Such silly mistakes can cost you games, the Irishmen need to learn quickly.
Driven towards the mid off region.
In line of the stumps, defended solidly off the front foot.

FOUR! Is that a dropped catch? Very close for comfort though. Back of a length outside off, O'Brien flashes at it but gets a thick outside edge. Janat at wide first slip jumps to his right but it goes past him in a flash and races to the fence. The boundary has ruined the over.
Outside off, pushed away towards covers.
Full outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a single.
Well played! Waits for the back of the length ball and guides it past the backward point fielder. It is in the gap and the batsmen take a couple.
Back of a length ball around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Pitched up ball around off, kept out watchfully.
Naib is switching ends again.
Slower through the air, kept out watchfully.
Wide! Around off, spinning down sharply as Kevin tries to play it but misses. That was a harsh call perhaps. It spun a lot and the batsman had shuffled as well.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They manage to come back for the second.

A strong shout for a caught behind falls on deaf ears! Quicker one outside off, O'Brien goes for the drive but seems to have missed it. Spotting the keeper go up, Khan starts appealing loudly too but to no effect. There was a noise which the on-air commentators inform us and that might have been of the bat hitting the pad.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Quicker one outside off, Andy pokes at it and gets beaten.
Waits for it and plays it against the spin to the leg side for a single.
Change of ends for Rashid Khan.
Leans ahead to this one and works it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a single. Another productive over for Afghanistan.
Kevin O'Brien strides out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The bowling change has resulted in favour of Afghanistan. The temptation must have been to give Rashid a longer run but sometimes unexpected changes bring you gifts. Nabi slows this one as he tosses it up around off, Simi Singh leans ahead gingerly in order to defend it but doesn't commit himself. As a result, the ball takes the bottom edge and rolls to the off stump. The bails come off. The hosts are losing their way. They still need 135 from 139 balls with only 6 wickets in the kitty.
Full loopy ball on middle and leg, knocked down to long on to change strike.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Short ball outside off, Simi rocks back and cuts it towards point.
Singh leans ahead to this one and strokes it back to the bowler.
Nabi is back on.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
On a length outside off, played with an open bat-face to the point fielder.
Length ball outside off, Balbirnie waits for it and dabs it to third man for a run.
Too full and straight on this occasion, clipped away nicely to deep mid-wicket for a single.
In the zone outside off, Simi plants his front foot across to allow it through.
Fuller length ball outside off, Andy strokes it through to sweeper cover for a single.
Gulbadin Naib comes back for a bowl.
Full ball outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Two Wides! Khan slips this one down the leg side, Singh misses out on his flick and the keeper also doesn't collect it properly. Another extra run results.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Quicker one outside off, Simi tries put bat to ball but misses.
FOUR! Shot! Slower through the air, Singh crouches and sweeps it hard over mid-wicket as the ball races to the fence.
Outside off, Singh pushes at it but misses.

That was so, so close! Didn't know why it was turned down. Quicker one on middle, skids after hitting the deck. Singh shuffles and tries to sweep it away but is hit on the pads. Rashid appeals vociferously but the umpire stays put. The replay indicates that it was adjacent. Might have gone on to hit the middle stump. The woes of no technology being present for the series.
FOUR! Well executed! Tossed up around off, Balbirnie kneels and sweeps it through mid-wicket to find the fence. It has been a good percentage shot for him.
Slower through the air, Andy hangs back and taps it to the leg side.
Singh backs away to the shorter one and punches it against the spin through covers for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower through the air around off, swept away nicely to deep square leg for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Streaky but effective! Tossed up outside off, Balbirnie goes for a drive but gets an outside edge past the slip fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Andy leans ahead and taps it to the cover region.
On a shorter length, defended solidly off the back foot.
The wrong one from Rashid as Andy tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Quicker one outside off, Balbirnie goes for the sweep but misses it completely.
Starts off with a conventional leg break outside off, Andy waits for it and plays it with an angled bat to point.
Here comes Rashid Khan. He was phenomenal in the T20I series. We all know how effective he can prove to be. Can he weave his magic in the first ODI as well?

A loud appeal for an LBW falls on deaf ears!  Spinning in from outside off, Singh leans ahead to block it but misses it to get pinged on the front pad. A confident appeal follows but the umpire is unmoved. Impact was the issue there.
Quicker and flatter, defended from the comfort of the crease.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
The shorter length allows Singh to line it up as he cuts it away but the only problem is that he picks out the extra cover fielder.
On a flatter trajectory, Singh hangs back and dead-bats it.
Tossed up around off, Balbirnie kneels and brings out his favoured sweep shot. Executes it well to get it towards deep square leg for a single.
Andy waits for the length ball and punches it away to sweeper cover for a single. 3 from this one, the Irishmen need to be smart about strike rotation.
Edged but safe! Fuller length ball outside off, Singh pushes at it with hard hands but gets an outside edge towards third man. A run taken.
Wide! Short but way outside off, Simi chases it and misses.
There was no conviction whatsoever in that stroke! Back of a length ball around off, Singh tries to run it down to third man but has no space to work with. Gets beaten as a result.
Pitched up delivery just outside off, eased off the front foot to the mid off fielder.
Short and a lot of room on offer, Singh throws his bat at it but gets a bottom edge. The keeper dives to his right and parries it towards the first slip fielder.
Back of a length around off, Singh plays it with soft hands towards point and is set to take off. However, he runs back spotting the fielder attacking it. He needs to be careful.

Indecision from the Irishmen once again! On a flatter trajectory outside off, Balbirnie taps it towards short third man and takes off. He looks at his partner who is not interested. The fielder runs in but overruns it. No harm done though. 2 from this one.
Slower through the air outside off, eased off the front foot to the cover region.
Stays back to the shorter one and punches it down to long on for a single.
Loopy full ball on middle and off, Singh leans ahead and taps it towards mid on.
Tossed up delivery around off, kept out nicely.
Slower through the air, broomed away with the spin to deep square leg for a run.

Time for Drinks! Afghanistan continue to chip away at the wickets and have a strong grip on the game. Ireland are definitely not fancying the two-paced nature of the track. However, they only have themselves to blame as they have lost wickets to poor shot selections. They still need 167 from 186 balls. Need to keep rotating the strike or else the pressure will keep mounting on them. An absorbing passage awaits us.

FOUR! Flashed and flashed hard! Short and wide, plenty of width on offer so Simi Singh decides to take this one on. Cracks it square and beats the diving effort of the fielder at point. He moves to his left but can't stop it. Third man can't cut it off and that's a boundary.
Takes the pace off this one as Naib bowls it on a fullish length. In line of the stumps, so Simi Singh gets right behind the line and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full in length and outside off, driven through mid off for an easy run.
Back of a length delivery, too straight in line, Balbirnie works it off his hips through the mid-wicket area for a couple of runs.
Full ball speared in on off, Andy drives it back down the track for nothing.
Tossed up on off, swept away to deep square leg for a single. A wicket and 3 runs from the over.
Wonderful bowling from Nabi! He bowls the straighter one this time around off. Balbirnie plays for the non-existent turn and gets beaten.
Simi Singh comes out to bat.

OUT! A brilliant piece of fielding from Shahidi! These kind of moments make you stand out as a team. Tossed up ball around off, Balbirnie kneels and sweeps this one off the toe end of the bat towards wide mid on. He takes off initially and Nial trusts his call. However, Shahidi runs to his left and dives full length to stop the ball and at that time, Andy tells O'Brien to go back. It is too late as the fielder lobs the ball back to Nabi and he does the rest as Niall is stranded halfway. The Afghanistan players are beaming as the Irishmen are going downhill.
Andy fetches this one from outside off and under edges it onto his pads. Lucky as it could have rolled back to his stumps.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Slower through the air, swept away to deep square leg for a run.
Back of a length outside off, slapped away off the back foot to the point region.
Risky! The leg cutter from Naib around off, grips on the surface and cuts away. Andy fishes at it and misses. He almost edged that one.
Good shot but for no run! Overpitched outside off, the right-hander drives it sweetly but he does so straight to the extra cover fielder. A meter either side of him and it would have been a boundary.
Similar delivery, a similar defense presented by Balbirnie as he blocks it with authority.
Good length ball around off, Andy camps back and stonewalls it.
Full length ball around off, Balbirine comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Slower through the air, sliding in. Niall comes forward and blocks it down the track.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Turning in slowly, tucked to the man at 45.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. 50 comes up for Ireland.
Leans ahead to the full ball and brooms it away to deep backward square leg for a run.
Spinning in as Andy taps it towards mid-wicket.
On a length on off, kept out watchfully.

Safe! However, just by a whisker! O'Brien punches this length ball through point and calls for two. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and throws it back to Shafiqullah who is standing near the stumps. He spots that Niall is jogging towards his end. So, he picks up the ball and flicks it back to the stumps as the batsman tries to amble in. The keeper is confident and it is referred upstairs. Well, the replays show that the southpaw didn't even try to ground his bat in, taking it so lightly but to his fortune, his right foot is just in when the bails come off. These are basics, you can't go wrong on that.
That was lazy stuff from Niall O'Brien! This can land him into big trouble. Good presence of mind from the keeper. Is the southpaw run out? Seems to be touch and go.
Short and room on offer, Andy flays at it but gets it off the outer half towards third man. A single taken.

That could have very well carried to Naib. Another occasion where the ball has stopped on the pitch. Length ball around off, Andy checks his shot towards the bowler. He  dives to his left but the ball just lands in front of him. He has a wry smile on his face.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Pitched up ball outside off, driven crisply to sweeper cover for a single.
Full ball on middle and leg, tapped gently to the on side. A decent start from Nabi, only 4 from it.

Balbirnie must have had his heart in his mouth! Quicker and on a flatter trajectory around off, Andy doesn't move his feet much as he tries to dead-bat it but gets an inside edge that bounces over the leg stump. So close yet so far.
Good shot selection from the southpaw as it is full in length. The spin is out of the equation as he crouches and sweeps it away to deep backward square leg. A run taken.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, O'Brien tries to work it across but misses.
On a flatter trajectory and shorter in length, defended solidly off the back foot.
Slower through the air, dips in. Andy strokes it through mid on to rotate strike.
Starts off with a full ball on middle and leg, helped to the man at 45 for a single.
Mohammad Nabi to roll his arm over now.
Length ball outside off, Nial watches it closely and runs it down to third man for a single.
Continues to bowl the back of the length delivery, O'Brien gets behind it and defends it nicely.
A loud shout of No from Balbirnie! Niall stays back and taps this one towards point. Sets off for the run but his partner sends him back quickly seeing the fielder attack the ball.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full ball attacking the stumps, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle and off, kept out watchfully.
Once again too straight and it has been turned away through square leg for a single. Another tidy over from Rahman, only 2 from it. He is keeping the pressure on.
Balbirnie strides forward to the tossed up ball and eases it down to mid on for an easy run.
Full and outside off, squeezed out to the man at point.
This one is pushed quicker outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Drifting in again, worked away towards short mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery in line of the stumps, Andy turns it to mid-wicket.
Slightly overpitched in line of the stumps, driven to mid on. Another successful over for the visitors.
Niall is off the mark! Full ball, coming in, flicked nicely to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Niall O'Brien is the new man in.

OUT! A poor shot and  that has brought about his downfall! Not good from the hosts, they are not applying themselves and are paying the result. A length ball well outside off, Porterfield goes at it with hard hands, attempting to play it over covers but only manages to get an outside edge behind. Shafiqullah behind the stumps moves to his left and takes his second catch. A dream start for Afghanistan and they continue to make early inroads.
Full and straight, played with a closed bat face to the mid-wicket fielder.
Porterfield shuffles a touch, covers the line of the ball and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Full length ball outside off, eased to sweeper cover for a run.
Time for Powerplay 2! Maximum of four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Meanwhile, Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack.
Nicely done! Shortish ball, William rocks back and cuts it away through point. Rashid chases it and keeps the batsmen down to a couple.
Fuller in length, Balbirnie leans ahead and sweeps it away to deep square leg for a run.
Slower through the air, Andy comes ahead and defends it solidly.
Wide! Drifting in too much and Balbirnie misses his flick.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Well bowled! Rahman goes wider of the crease and tossed this one around off. It spins away sharply to go past the attempted push of William.
Tossed up outside off, eased away towards covers.
On a length, coming in again, Andy tries to work it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length ball outside off, Andy stays back and places it towards the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Sweet! Shortish ball outside off, Balbirnie stands tall and strokes it away through covers to pick up a boundary.
Good length ball, shaping in. Andy tries to work it away but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Good length ball outside off, angling in. Balbirnie points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Balbirnie goes down and sweeps this full ball on off to the man at deep backward square leg. The fielder on the boundary keeps it to just a single.
Flighted again by Rahman, attacking the line of the stumps. Balbirnie watchfully defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up just outside the off stump, Porterfield does well to drive this one through covers. The batsmen swap ends.
A short of a length delivery is cut straight to point.

FOUR! Good use of the feet. Porterfield sees the flight on this one, uses his feet well to reach to the pitch of the ball and drives it through the cover region. The exquisite timing and placement earns Porterfield another boundary.
Tossed up delivery on off, driven to mid off but there is no chance of a single.
Andy Balbirnie comes out to bat.

OUT! Afghanistan have drawn first blood! Alam keeps it on a fullish length outside off and the ball moves away ever so slightly. Stirling comes forward half-heartedly and pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge which is pouched safely by Shafiqullah. Stirling has to take the long walk back and is not happy at all.
A back of a length ball outside off is punched off the back foot towards the cover region.
Bowls a fullish delivery shaping into the batsman, Stirling tries to work it on the leg side but misses, again gets hit on the pads.
Full length delivery just on the off stump is defended off the front foot.

Stirling tries to pull this short of a length delivery. The ball sticks in the surface and does not come on as the batsman expected. He is early into the pull and the ball takes the toe end of the bat and hits the inner part of his pads. No run.
Stirling shows respect to this length ball around the off stump, gets forward and defends with the full face of the bat.
Drifting in this time, tucked nicely towards mid-wicket.
Waits for this one to do its bit and plays it away with the spin towards point.
Shorter in length, William hangs back and punches it out.
Slower through the air, Porterfield comes forward and blocks it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery
Full on middle and leg, turned towards short fine leg for a run.
Ends with a back of a length ball on the off stump. Porterfield defends it off the front foot, presenting the full face of the bat.
Leg Bye! Full ball angling into the batsman, Stirling tries to flick it but misses, gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls down towards the covers region. They cross over for a quick single.
Stirling gets right behind the line of this straight length delivery and blocks it out.
Marginally back of a length delivery is defended off the back foot.
Stirling shoulders his arms to this length ball outside off.
Alam keeps it just behind a length on the off pole. Stirling goes back and defends.
Tossed up ball on the stumps, leans across and works it towards the mid-wicket region. No chance of a single there.

Close shave! The batsman seems to be lucky here. This straighter and quicker one from Rahman stays a bit low, goes past Porterfield's attempted flick and hits him right in front of the stumps. There is a big confident appeal from the visiting team, but the umpire surprisingly turns it down. The replays also show that it was really close.
Flighted delivery on off, Porterfield does not read the speed and goes for the drive. Gets an outside edge and the ball goes past the slip fielder. No run though.
Stirling moves across his stump and works this tossed up ball on middle and off towards the mid-wicket region. The batsmen cross over for a single.
Flatter again by Mujeeb, Stirling goes behind and taps it towards the point region.
Flatter delivery on the off stump line, Stirling gets in line and plays it back to the bowler.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Once again a sign that this is a two-paced track! Short ball which doesn't take off much. Porterfield is bemused as he tries to pull it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! Shortish ball and some room on offer, Porterfield waits for it and pushes it with great timing through covers. The fielder chases it and puts in a desperate dive near the ropes in order to cut it off. It is again being checked upstairs. Well, this time the fielder was in contact with the ropes when he had the ball in his hand. A boundary results.
Pitched up ball on middle and off, driven crisply to the mid off fielder.
Similar length ball around off, played with an open bat-face towards the point region.
Tentative! Back of a length ball, shaping away. Porterfield flirts with it and misses.

Shortish ball outside off, Porterfield stands tall and punches it nicely through covers. Rashid Khan hares after it like a cheetah, slides and tries to keep the ball in play. The umpire refers it upstairs. Well, the replays are not that conclusive but the third umpire rules it in favour of the fielder. Three runs the result.
Porterfield strides forward to the straighter one and turns it to the leg side.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Coming in with the arm this time, William leans ahead and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish and drifting in, pushed off the front foot back towards the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, played gently towards covers.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. The spin test begins for the Irishmen.

A huge shout for an LBW hasn't been given! Full ball, tailing in appreciably. Stirling tries to block it but misses it. The ball brushes his pads and carries to the keeper. Alam rises up in an appeal but the umpire turns it down. Perhaps, no bat there.

FOUR! So, so close! Alam has his hands on his heads. In the corridor of uncertainty, Stirling comes ahead tentatively and pushes at it but gets an inside edge that just goes past the stumps, beats the keeper and runs to the fence behind.
Angling in on a length, played with a closed bat face towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Stirling is off the mark in style! Gets a gentle loosener outside off. He strides ahead and creams it through covers for a delightful boundary.
Another good delivery as it shapes in sharply, Stirling clips it watchfully towards short mid-wicket.

What a beauty to start with! Alam almost caught Porterfield off guard. Runs in and attacks the stumps with an inswiging yorker. The southpaw is a bit late to react but manages to get it away off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket. Ireland and William are away!

We are back for the chase. The men who matter stride out to the middle. Paul Stirling and William Porterfield to open the batting for Ireland. Aftab Alam to steam in with the first new ball. A wide first slip in place. Here we go...
